schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.application_route: Apply to a Member Lending Institution (bank/NBFC/MFI) or via the MUDRA portal.

criteria.description: Non-corporate, non-farm micro/small business (manufacturing, trading, services; allied activities included)
Loan amount within PMMY limit of INR 10 lakh

source.title: PMMY launch 8 Apr 2015; limit INR 10 lakh

criteria.description: Non-corporate, non-farm micro/small business (manufacturing, trading, services; allied activities included)
Loan amount within PMMY limit of INR 20 lakh
Loans above INR 10 lakh (Tarun Plus) require successful repayment of a prior Tarun-category loan

notes: Guarantee coverage for PMMY loans up to INR 20 lakh is stated to be under CGFMU.

source.title: PIB: PMMY loan limit raised to INR 20 lakh, effective 24 Oct 2024

items: Quotation or project estimate for the asset/working capital

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
schemes.administrator: CGTMSE (Ministry of MSME / SIDBI) via Member Lending Institutions
schemes.application_route: No direct application to CGTMSE: request coverage through a Member Lending Institution (bank/NBFC) when applying for a collateral-free loan.

criteria.description: Classified as Micro or Small enterprise
Facility sought without collateral or third-party guarantee

notes: Guarantee cover is reported to be capped at INR 5 crore of credit; sources conflict on whether larger facilities are ineligible or only capped. Confirm with the lender.

source.title: Revamp of Credit Guarantee Scheme effective 1 Apr 2023 (ceiling INR 2 crore to INR 5 crore)

unverified_details: Guarantee coverage percentages (sources report 75-90% depending on category) are deliberately NOT modelled.
Annual guarantee fee schedule is deliberately NOT modelled.

items: Financial statements and bank statements as required by the lender
